_rule: Prepared 2026-11-04 before live; no authorization. Bits judged independently.

shot-sparse-on-a.source: Same-run OFF-repeat noise and float encoding uncertainty; water-compose mean divided by exposure.
shot-sparse-on-a.deciding_observable: bit 1: every ON energy, coverage, truncation and reflections GPU median/p90
shot-sparse-on-a.pass_rule: Every ON within same-bit OFF energy and coverage repeat noise; invalid=0 and world truncated=0. Both ON cost medians and p90 improve beyond OFF-repeat spread; otherwise reject the bit. Missing observations INVALID.
